summary: Deck search (#312: Ikoma Shizuka, Imperial Gift) and look-at-the-top-N (#322, in via #329: Public Records, Isawa Tamaki, Bayushi Kahoku exp2, Banish All Doubt, Signs and Portents), with origin/main ddb58847 merged in (#324 Battle Phase timing and Daidoji Yuki, #327 multi-reaction window, #330, #325, #332 Discipline/Absent flags and Return to Action strategy-wave-18). Both sides kept in every conflict: AbilityDefinition = main's ActionKeywords/Discipline/Absent then this branch's Search/Look as the last parameters (all callers use named arguments); MatchView = main's BattleStep then PendingSearch/ShownCards/PendingLook; personality-wave-25/26, follower-wave-15 and strategy-wave-18 registered ahead of this branch's waves and now guarded against by them; the TrainingOpponent and QueryActions branches carry both sets. Pinned published count re-derived at 407 = 400 on origin/main (counted from the JSON files) + 7 from this branch. New test BeforeActionWindowAheadOfLookAndSearch pins that the #327 before-action window resolves ahead of a Limited look or search.
validation: bash tools/check.sh (full, Godot import and smoke included) passed on the merged tree: 216 core, 57 published, 18 gold-parity, 20 gold-quote, 23 battle-timing, 11 recon-action, 14 discipline-absent, 9 deck-format, 10 deck-workshop, 22 deck-search, 15 deck-look, 22 ai, 8 server, 7 client transport, python content tests. Mutations re-run on the merged tree and caught: look view visible to the opponent, generator state not persisted after a shuffle, an extra setup draw (SetupShufflesUnchanged), and the shared tail no longer passing priority (fails the new interaction test). No existing test needed a semantic change. The first Godot import after resetting .import files prints get_multiple_md5 null-file errors (asset cache warmup, unrelated); the rerun is clean.
remaining: Client UI for the deck viewer and the look arrangement (#314, #315, #323, Alfredo). Rules questions awaiting Mendon are in docs/decisions/2026-09-18-deck-search-primitive.md and 2026-09-18-look-top-cards-primitive.md. Known gap documented in the look decision doc: the shared tail of a deferred search or look does not run the after-your-[keyword]-action traits, Apprentice Shinobi, additional-action forfeiture or the Legion of the Bat / Nikutai windows; none of the seven wired cards carries Recon or Ninja.
